user.title: Connect to AKVO Movable Floor
user.description: Enter the Modbus TCP address of your AKVO Spiralift controller. The integration will test the connection before continuing.

data_description.host: IP address or hostname of the AKVO Modbus TCP server. See your project-specific map document (725-<project>) for the address.

presets.title: Preset names & command gate
presets.description: Give each AKVO configuration preset a friendly name (for example "Pool mode" or "Deck mode"). Leave a name blank to hide that preset. The command gate is **OFF by default** — only turn it on after the register map and on-hardware watchdog validation are fully approved.

data_description.preset_1: Friendly name shown in the Home Assistant UI for AKVO configuration §1. Leave blank to hide.
data_description.preset_2: Friendly name for AKVO configuration §2. Leave blank to hide.
data_description.preset_3: Friendly name for AKVO configuration §3. Leave blank to hide.
data_description.preset_4: Friendly name for AKVO configuration §4. Leave blank to hide.
data_description.preset_5: Friendly name for AKVO configuration §5. Leave blank to hide.
data_description.preset_6: Friendly name for AKVO configuration §6. Leave blank to hide.
data_description.preset_7: Friendly name for AKVO configuration §7. Leave blank to hide.
data_description.preset_8: Friendly name for AKVO configuration §8. Leave blank to hide.
data_description.enable_commands: ⚠️ SAFETY: Leave this OFF until (1) the project register map (725-<project>) is verified against the register-map overrides, (2) on-hardware watchdog validation has passed, and (3) a qualified operator has approved. Commands are rejected by default.

register_map.title: Register map overrides (project-specific)
register_map.description: Leave all fields at their defaults unless your project-specific AKVO map document (725-<project>) specifies different register addresses or bit positions. **Incorrect values here will break safety detection.** Verify against your 725-<project> document and confirm on hardware before enabling commands.

data_description.reg_hr_status_1: Holding register address for General Status Word 1 (HR0 in example map 725-XXXXX).
data_description.reg_hr_status_2: Holding register address for General Status Word 2 (HR1 in example map).
data_description.reg_hr_fault_main: Holding register address for main-floor drive fault word (HR2 in example map).
data_description.reg_hr_fault_baja: Holding register address for Baja drive fault word (HR3 in example map).
data_description.reg_hr_fault_topplate: Holding register address for top-plate fault word (HR4 in example map).
data_description.reg_hr_outputs: Holding register address for output word (HR5 in example map).
data_description.reg_hr_pos_main: Holding register address for main floor position in mm (HR6 in example map).
data_description.reg_hr_pos_baja: Holding register address for Baja position in mm (HR7 in example map).
data_description.reg_hr_current_main: Holding register address for main motor current in cA (HR8 in example map).
data_description.reg_hr_current_baja: Holding register address for Baja motor current in cA (HR9 in example map).
data_description.reg_hr_command: Holding register address for the external command word (HR10 in example map). This is the write register for configuration requests.
data_description.reg_hr_watchdog: Holding register address for the external watchdog mirror (HR11 in example map).
data_description.reg_s1_system_ready: Bit position in Status Word 1 for the system-ready flag (bit 0 in example map).
data_description.reg_s1_system_fault: Bit position in Status Word 1 for the system-fault flag (bit 1 in example map).
data_description.reg_s1_estop_indoor: Bit position in Status Word 1 for indoor emergency stop (bit 3 in example map).
data_description.reg_s1_estop_outdoor: Bit position in Status Word 1 for outdoor emergency stop (bit 4 in example map).
data_description.reg_s1_watchdog_from_akvo: Bit position in Status Word 1 for the AKVO watchdog signal to mirror (bit 13 in example map).
data_description.reg_s1_bad_modbus_comm: Bit position in Status Word 1 for the bad-Modbus-comm fault (bit 14 in example map).
data_description.reg_s1_ready_for_external: Bit position in Status Word 1 for ready-for-external-commands gate (bit 15 in example map).
data_description.reg_s2_floors_moving: Bit position in Status Word 2 for the floors-moving flag (bit 0 in example map).
data_description.reg_s2_config_achieved_base: Base bit position in Status Word 2 for configuration-achieved flags. Config N achieved = bit (base + N - 1). (bit 2 in example map).
data_description.reg_cmd_move_config_base: Base bit position in the command word for move-to-config requests. Config N = bit (base + N - 1). (bit 1 in example map). Bit 0 (System Reset) is never written.
data_description.reg_wd_external: Bit position in the watchdog register for the external watchdog mirror (bit 0 in example map).
data_description.reg_topplate_fault_count: Number of top-plate fault bits in the top-plate fault word (14 in example map).
data_description.reg_min_config: Minimum valid configuration number (1 in example map).
data_description.reg_max_config: Maximum valid configuration number (8 in example map).

error.cannot_connect: Unable to connect to the AKVO Modbus server. Check the IP address and port, and ensure the controller is reachable.

abort.already_configured: This AKVO server is already configured.
abort.reconfigure_successful: Host and port updated. The integration will reload with the new address.
